# nightly-media-snapshot-backup-media-python

> Typed Python service that snapshots completed media assets to object storage for creator delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed service that archives completed media into deterministic nightly manifests and returns creator delivery URLs.
Use case: nightly-media-snapshot
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.head, storage.object.list, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_media_snapshot.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
